findings.title: No Arabic font in the stack
findings.message: "IBM Plex Arabic" is named but never loaded.
findings.fix: Load an Arabic family with @font-face or a font link and name it in the stack, for example "IBM Plex Sans Arabic".

findings.title: Arabic set too small
findings.fix: Keep Arabic UI text at 14px or more, and body text at 16px.

findings.title: A label in a different language from its element
findings.message: The aria-label "chg language" is read as ar.
findings.fix: Put lang on the element to match the label, or write the label in the language of the element.
findings.snippet:
<div class="lang" role="group" aria-label="chg language">
        <button id="langAr" class="active" type="button" aria-pressed="true">العربية</button>
